_about: Every journey photo made to the Journey Engine V2 handoff (section 4): where it's from, who took it, its licence, and the treatment it got. `original` is the untouched download, here in photo-originals; `processed` is the copy the app uses, made by scripts/process-photos.mjs, which also fills in `treatment` and `qa` each time it runs.
CC BY-SA photos stay CC BY-SA once treated (the treated copy is an adaptation), and every photo is credited in the README.

`download_url` is exactly what was downloaded for `original` (the full file, or Commons' own scaled copy of a very large one). The originals themselves aren't kept in git: `npm run photos -- --fetch` downloads any that are missing.
